gather_tensor_across_gpus: gather a tensor from all GPUs into a single concatenated tensor using the gather function
gather_nograd_tensor_no_grad: gather a tensor from all GPUs without gradient tracking using gather_nograd
varsize_gather_nograd_variable_size: gather tensors of different sizes across GPUs by padding to max size then trimming
get_rank_current_process: get the current process rank in a distributed training setup using get_rank
weighted_average_across_gpus: compute a weighted average of a scalar value across all GPUs using weighted_average
